{{Top|leg}}
'''Private investigators''' were individuals who basically did work-for-hire contract jobs for whomever could afford their prices. Work could include, but was not limited to [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguarding]], security, looking for lost items and individuals. Many who worked as P.I.'s often had a previous [[Police officer/Legends|career]] in [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]], the military, or some kind of related security work.
